patterns.note: Asymmetric two-column layout for introductory content, with a wider left column for primary text and a narrower right column for supporting details (services, studio approach).
Extremely large, fixed display typeface for the hero section, creating a strong visual anchor that content scrolls over, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body and navigation.
High-contrast black and white base palette with a vibrant, almost neon, lime green used as a primary accent color for CTAs, interactive elements, and occasional background fills.

The oversized hero text 'ALLEYWAY DESIGNS' remains fixed in the viewport, creating a parallax effect as subsequent content scrolls over it. Project cards and other content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up as they enter the viewport.

Project showcases are presented as a dense, full-bleed grid of image cards, each with a project title and a 'Thinking about a project?' call-to-action on hover (not visible in static images, but implied by the text).

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, fixed text element that acts as a background layer, allowing the main page content to scroll over it, creating a depth-of-field parallax effect. A sticky navigation bar maintains persistent access to key sections as the user scrolls. Content sections and individual elements within grids are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely a combination of fade-ins and subtle upward translations, leveraging CSS keyframes for smooth transitions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display font (~6-8x body) for hero and section titles, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation, maintaining a clear typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with an airy hero section due to large typography and ample whitespace, transitioning to a denser grid layout for project showcases.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an enormous, fixed hero text that content scrolls over, combined with a high-contrast lime green accent, creates a bold, almost brutalist aesthetic that feels both modern and unique, avoiding generic marketing templates.
